output.scope_note: The paper is a phase-field electro-chemo-mechanical model of Li-metal voiding against an LLZO solid electrolyte, and it reports one ionic conductivity value for LLZO (Table 1, taken from Buschmann et al., 2012).

records.unit_evidence_quote: Ionic conductivity of solid electrolyte (LLZO), σel [S m−1 ]
records.notes: Table 1 row 'Ionic conductivity of solid electrolyte (LLZO), σel'; the value is a model input cited from Buschmann et al. (2012) (footnote iv), not measured in this paper. The table's T = 298 K is the simulation temperature and is not used as the measurement temperature. Electronic conductivity of Li metal (1.1 × 10^7 S m−1) and the diffusion coefficient are excluded.
